notes.title: NEW PRICES
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Game lovers[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]In order to make our game more accessible to you, we have discounted the prices of our game by approximately 50%. PLATFORM games are now affordable for everyone.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Crazy Miners - New Game
notes.content:
[i][h1][b]Hello[/b][/h1][/i]
[h3]We would like to tell you about the new game we made.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444570/Crazy_Miners/

[b]In this game, very difficult tracks await you on your journey as you start as a miner. You will have to pass many tracks and fight hundreds of creatures. You will need to strengthen your character and complete more challenging missions.[/b]

[b]You can add it to your wish list and be informed about the next update and release date of the game.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192437/94e0a936a05f421ffd002085e0cb003448c44f57.png[/img]

notes.title: Platform - Update
notes.content:
[b][h3]Improvements:[/h3]

- More tips added.
- Some bugs fixed.
- Graphics quality increased.


We are working hard to provide you with a better experience. If you have a problem with the game or a question you want to ask, you can reach us at our discord address.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206240/Platform/

notes.title: Platform
notes.content:
[h3][b]Platform[/b][/h3]
[h3][i][b]We are excited to present our new project Platform! Check out the game now and don't forget to add it to your wishlist below!
[/b][/i][/h3]


[b]Platform: Humans are trapped on a platform filled with evolved creatures. Scientists are investigating whether the creatures feed on fear. You must complete missions and find clues that you need to find.[/b]
